rootCause.summary: CoreEventToolModelProbeRun.agent/pre-step rejected the first claimed turn whenever the fixed host supplied the followup message together with its required working-directory runtime-context snapshot (2 messages). It required exactly 1 message, returned {kind:"reject"}, and the host removed the claimed inputs and ended the turn as blocked before any model request.

codePath: first step required payload.messages.length === 1 (pre-fix), then validateOwnerInput(payload.messages[0])
no user/message or model request is reached, so validateCommittedInputs/stream never run and all counters stay 0

offlineReproduction.description: Synthetic host claims [fixed prompt, exact bound cwd runtime-context] into the first pre-step; pre-fix receipt matches the host failure exactly.
offlineReproduction.failingExpectation: test "a host-injected working-directory snapshot in the first claimed turn is accepted and the round proceeds" expected passed, pre-fix receipt was status=failed, reasonCode=CORE_MODEL_PROBE_PROTOCOL_VIOLATION, counters all 0, released/disposed/archived true — the same shape as the host attempt.

fix.change: The probe first step now accepts exactly 1–2 claimed messages instead of only 1. Message 1 must equal the registered fixed prompt by id and native message hash; if message 2 exists it must be the exact bound working-directory runtime-context (same validateRuntimeContext used by committed-input validation). Any other count (>2, 0) or identity still fails closed before any model request. The post-pre-step decision.messages pass through the same first-step validator, so the whole turn admits at most those two inputs.
notRelaxed: exactly one registered owner prompt (id + hash) and no user-controlled text
at most two inputs: one optional exact cwd runtime-context; a third input, a different cwd/section/shape or a non-runtime-context message is rejected
downstream committed user/message validation and stream validation still admit at most those two inputs; unregistered inbox insertions still stop the run
requests/streams ≤2, turns=1, exactly one shiyu_core_event_types tool call/result, only the read-only types tool may execute
maxTokens 256 with second request = 256 − first reported outputTokens; tool timeout, usage completeness and unknown rules unchanged
no retry, no Goal/Task/budget/Effect/event/business write; flush/release/dispose/archive still mandatory for any receipt

suppressRuntimeContextDecision.reason: The fixed host injects its required working-directory snapshot into the first claimed turn even with systemPrompt.suppressRuntimeContext(); the snapshot is context the host requires and is already exact-bound by content. Removing suppression or adding a deny/restrict guard would not remove this snapshot and could admit or silently drop unrelated host context. No setup change is needed; the probe accepts exactly the host-required snapshot and rejects anything else.
